messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: New Version of shinyapps package
parts:
Folks,

I just released a new version of shinyapps package (0.3.1). Older versions of the shinyapps package will no longer work. You will need update shinyapps package using:
if (!require("devtools"))
    install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: New Version of shinyapps package
parts:
Franics,

You're devtools package is out of date. You need to update devtools to >= 1.4.

install.packages('devtools')

Cheers,
-Andy
